name: Smoked Ham, Cabbage & Mustard Seed
desc: Soft winter cabbage with savoury smoked ham and a quiet mustard-seed warmth
ing: 110 g ready-to-eat cooked smoked ham, chopped
170 g Savoy cabbage, very finely shredded
½ tsp yellow mustard seeds, crushed
method: Chop fresh vegetables into small pieces and use ONLY fully cooked ready-to-eat meat, removing bones, skin and inedible pieces.
Pour around 125 ml cold water into the 1-litre soup maker, then add all ingredients except those marked (finish).
Top up with cold water to roughly 850–900 ml TOTAL, remaining strictly within the 800 ml MIN and 1,000 ml MAX fill marks.
Run Smooth for approximately 19 minutes.
Ensure the ham is steaming hot; mustard should remain understated.
